text:
Aisha: Heads-up — saw ~5% drop on q4b-int4-v2 vs fp16 on the HEM benchmark. Numbers look prompt-sensitive, especially long/multiturns. Can we triage?

Ben: Drop the eval command and sample ids, I can repro.

Aisha: repro command below:
```
./rwt eval --model q4b-int4-v2 --dataset promptbank/holdout-2025 --metrics accuracy,macro_f1 --batch 64
```
Outputs: accuracy: 0.723 (fp16: 0.769); macro_f1: 0.68 -> 0.71

Carlos: tagging label ops — could this be a golden-set drift? we refreshed anchors last week.

Carlos: @Dana any infra changes overnight? :thinking:

Dana: No infra bumps since Friday. GPU fleet on driver 495. We did restart a few dedicated nodes for maintenance that night.

Ben: ran a quick per-prompt delta — concentrated on long-context prompts with multi-turn state. Could be KV cache truncation or tokenization mismatch.

Aisha: I noticed deltas mostly on prompts with fenced code blocks and bullet lists (formatting-heavy).

Ben: quick per-prompt diff snippet:
```
id: abc123 delta_acc: -0.23 tokens_in: 102
id: def456 delta_acc: -0.18 tokens_in: 340  # long
id: ghi789 delta_acc: -0.12 tokens_in: 48
```

labeler-bot: Reminder: 3 labelers currently on duty. Queue length: 240. ETA for rapid golden refresh triage: ~12h.

Carlos: Proposed action items:
1) re-run eval with fp16 baseline using identical tokenizer/tokenization flags,
2) run q4b-int4 with `--kv-policy preserve-prefix`,
3) surface top-100 failing prompts to labelers for quick sanity checks (formatting/hallucination/deid).

Aisha: Agree. Assign labelers to a new workspace "rapid-golden-check" and mark the high-variance prompts.

Ben: Kicking off eval variants now: will run `--tokenizer v2` and `--kv-policy preserve-prefix`.

deploy-bot: Eval job started (job_id rweval-202104). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/rweval-202104

Aisha: If labelers flag hallucinations or deid failures we should gate any quant rollout.

Carlos: I'll create a small spreadsheet and ping labelers with the IDs + instructions. Also will run a dedupe pass (fuzzyhash) on the top-100 to avoid duplicate anchor noise.

Dana: If you need capacity I can spin up a burst dedicated node for 2h.

Ben: Quick infra note: quant build is using kernel v3 which reduces padding reruns — shouldn't affect correctness but might change longctx perf characteristics.

Aisha: Timeline? Need dev/ML sign-off before EOD.

Ben: Expect initial variant results in ~30m, labeler triage 4-6h.

Carlos: Pinged labelers, spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/rapid-golden-check (view/edit for labelers).

Aisha: Perfect. Holding the canary until labeler verdicts are in. :lock: 

Ben: Results: re-run with `--kv-policy preserve-prefix` and `--tokenizer v2` showed accuracy 0.755 (fp16 0.769) — partial recovery but still a gap. Uploaded top-50 failing ids to the spreadsheet.

labeler-bot: Update: 3 labelers processed 75/100 IDs so far — flags: 18 formatting/hallucination, 6 deid, remainder model-likely.

Carlos: Based on labels looks like a mix: tokenizer differences + quant noise on long sequences. I'll do a dedupe + micro-golden refresh containing the flagged examples.

Dana: Reserving a dedicated node for a 6h golden-rescore run, starting in 15m.

Ben: Preparing PR to force `tokenizer=v2` preprocessing and set `kv_policy=preserve-prefix` for q4b-int4-v2. Will include test harness and per-prompt regression alert.

Aisha: Thanks all. Plan: block wider rollout, land tokenizer/kv fixes, run micro-golden refresh and re-eval. Hold canary until labeler verdicts and rescore finish. :thumbsup:

Ben: I'll also add a short eval script to the repo to reproduce per-prompt deltas locally and a note for oncall.

Carlos: Looping in labelers for final confirmation, will post final tally when done.

Aisha: Closing loop once we have gold rescore + labels. Appreciate the quick turn.
